package.name: dual_arm_qp_controller
package.description:
ros2_control ControllerInterface for the dual-arm QP (C2.2 layer 3). Claims 12 position command interfaces (arms only) + 12 position state interfaces, runs the velocity-level QP at the controller_manager rate, integrates to position commands, and implements the D7 stream-health interlock (any single-arm stall -> both arms hold).
C4.3 S4 W1 adds cooperative transport: an external ObjectTaskRow is assembled per cycle by the anchored object task (dual_arm_object_task) and fed to the QP together with the frozen grasp-chain relative target. The transport is driven by ~/start_transport, frozen by ~/abort_transport, and reported on ~/transport_status.
